name: Forge War

rounds.endCondition: Simple game ends after round 7; epic game after round 6 of stage 3

categories.label: Prestige track after quests (incl. failed active quests)
categories.labelVi: Điểm uy tín trên track (kể cả nhiệm vụ thất bại)
categories.hint: Fail all still-active quests first: they score the parenthesised value of the last completed leg. Add 100 per 100-prestige token.

categories.label: Adventurer levels
categories.hint: Number of adventurers at each level: 1 prestige per level, level 4 is worth 5.

categories.label: Market cards owned
categories.hint: Sum of prestige on every market card owned: unique weapon designs, market bonus cards and claimed public designs.

categories.label: Blacksmith / bazaar bonus spaces
categories.hint: Prestige from claimed end-game bonus spaces (not used in the epic game): blacksmith 2 per unique and 1 per public design (not starting copper designs); bazaar 1 per completed quest, 1 per adventurer, 2 per permanent market bonus card, 1 per leftover resource.

categories.label: Leftover gold and resource value
categories.labelVi: Vàng và giá trị tài nguyên còn lại
categories.hint: Gold plus sell value of leftover resources (without Seller Savvy, excluding resources already used for the bazaar bonus). 1 prestige per 4.

tiebreakers.description: Player earlier in current player order wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Verified against the final Cephalofair rulebook (Isaac Childres). Epic game (3 stages) uses the same final scoring; optional bonus tiles in the epic game are not scored at the end. Solo variant not modelled.

sources.title: Forge War Rule Book - Final (linked from Cephalofair)
sources.section: End of Game (p.25); Market bonus actions (p.16)
